receipts.title: Receipts & verification
receipts.intro: Every receipt carries its own verification code. Scan the QR code on a receipt, or check one from here. Daily offering and audit-chain integrity is verified separately, at the bottom of this page.
receipts.searchPlaceholder: Receipt no., giver or payment reference
receipts.noCodeNote: This receipt was issued before verification codes existed. Generating one gives it a QR code without changing the receipt or its number.
receipts.codeIssuedBanner: A verification code was issued for {{receipt}}.
receipts.revokeNote: A member scanning this receipt will be told it is no longer valid. The offering itself is not changed.
receipts.voidedNote: This offering was voided, so its receipt can no longer be verified. Record a correction to issue a valid receipt.
receipts.historyEmpty: No audit entries for this receipt.
receipts.dailyHint: Verifies one day's tamper-evident log as a whole. This is the church's own audit check, separate from a receipt's QR code, which verifies one receipt.
receipts.dailyValid: The day's chain is intact. {{entries}} entries verified.
receipts.dailyBroken: The chain is broken at entry #{{id}}.
receipts.dailyEmpty: No audit entries were recorded that day.
receipts.dailyNotLinked: The entry after this day does not link back to it, so entries may have been removed.

reconciliation.title: Incoming payments
reconciliation.intro: Money that arrives in the church's own bank or mobile-money account, and what it was given for. A payment is not giving yet: an administrator matches it to a person and confirms what it is, and only then does it become an offering, with the same receipt, QR code and reports as a gift recorded at the front desk. Cash counted at the desk never appears here.
reconciliation.accountSwitchedOff: {{name}} is switched off. Nothing more will be read from it.
reconciliation.secretRotated: A new signing secret was issued for {{name}}.
reconciliation.secretNote: Copy this into your provider's webhook settings now. It is shown once and cannot be read again. If you lose it, rotate it.
reconciliation.accountsNote: Connect the accounts the church genuinely receives money into. Nothing here asks for a bank password or a mobile-money PIN: either you upload the statement that account already produces, or the provider posts its notifications to a signed address.
reconciliation.noAccounts: No church account is connected yet.
reconciliation.credentialsNote: A statement import needs no credentials at all. You export the file from the portal you already use and upload it here. A webhook account is given a signing secret, which is what proves a notification came from the provider.
reconciliation.uploadNote: Export the statement from your bank or mobile-money portal and upload it here (CSV, or a tab-separated file). Importing the same file twice never records a payment twice.
reconciliation.resultLine: {{inserted}} imported · {{duplicates}} already known · matched {{matched}} · needs review {{review}} · unmatched {{unmatched}}
reconciliation.rejectedTitle: Lines that could not be imported
reconciliation.paymentsNote: A payment becomes giving only when somebody confirms it. Matching says WHO gave; confirming says WHAT it was, and issues the receipt.
reconciliation.notConfirmable: The provider reports this payment as {{status}}, so it cannot be recorded as giving.
reconciliation.suggestionNote: The statement names {{name}}, who is in the member directory. Check before matching.
reconciliation.conflictNote: The reference quotes the giving code of {{suggested}}, but the payer named on the statement is a different member. A mistyped code looks exactly like this. Match the member you know paid it, or set the payment aside.
reconciliation.ignoreConfirm: Set this payment aside without recording giving?
reconciliation.confirmNote: This writes one offering with a receipt and a QR code, the same record the front desk writes.
reconciliation.dateNote: Starts on the day the money moved ({{date}}), not today.
reconciliation.chooseMember: Choose the member this came from first.
reconciliation.ignoredBanner: Set aside. No giving was recorded.
reconciliation.chooseService: Choose the service this belongs to.
